#1 Was just alerted that the link to steering committee from the HomePage was broken.

I have fixed it now. The page history reveals that on Dec 9 2025 a spammer had overwritten and renamed the page.

I’ll use this occasion to say the obvious:

It’s not a good look to nominally serve on a committee when de facto you are not engaged. Maybe this is an occasion for steering committee members who are not actually committed to step down.
